items.title: Show HN: Overdesigned Simple Solitaire
items.contentSnippet:
I got irritated by the maximalism and lack of aesthetics present in modern software when trying to find a nice solitaire.
A solitaire does not need a score, levels - and most of all it does not need to download anything, have user log in or do anything else except maintain game state.
So since software comes automatically nowadays, I decided as a weekend project to create the last solitaire I'll ever need.

items.contentSnippet:
